sn35.16:2.1: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ bhikkhave, imesaṃ channaṃ bāhirānaṃ āyatanānaṃ assādañca assādato, ādīnavañca ādīnavato, nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ …pe… abbhaññāsiṃ …pe…
